description: The plot illustrates how accuracy varies with the number of frames for four methods. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Frames,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 8 to 64 with plotted points at 8, 16, 32, and 64. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)”, uses a linear scale, and shows values from about 39% up to about 54% with evenly spaced tick marks every 2 percentage points (40, 42, 44, …, 54). The blue line with circular markers (solid) labeled “Ours (Dynamic Seg)” starts near 53.0% at 8 frames, rises to about 54.0% at 16 frames, then is about 53.8% at 32 frames and about 53.7% at 64 frames. The green line with circular markers (solid) labeled “Ours (Static 4-Seg)” starts near 52.6% at 8 frames, increases to about 53.6% at 16 frames, is about 53.8% at 32 frames, and about 53.8% at 64 frames. The orange line with square markers (solid) labeled “LLaVA” starts around 45.0% at 8 frames and decreases across the x-axis to about 43.0% at 16 frames, about 41.0% at 32 frames, and about 39.4% at 64 frames. The red line with square markers (solid) labeled “PLLaVA (DP 16)” is shown from 16 frames onward, at about 45.6% at 16 frames, decreasing to about 43.8% at 32 frames and about 42.2% at 64 frames.
